title: Discovered attacks
intro: Move one piece out of the way and the piece behind it attacks. Two threats in one move.

lessons.title: Unmask the attacker
lessons.summary: The moving piece makes one threat, the piece behind makes another.

steps.text: Your bishop on d3 stands between your queen and Black's queen. If the bishop moves, your queen attacks d6 at once.
Move the bishop with check, so Black has no time to save the queen.
steps.hint: The bishop can give check by taking a pawn.
steps.ifWrong: The bishop must move with a threat so strong that Black cannot rescue the queen.
steps.ifRight: Check! Black must deal with the king, and you take the queen next.

steps.text: When the piece behind gives check, it is a discovered check. Then the moving piece can grab almost anything.
Use a discovered check to win the queen.
steps.hint: When the bishop leaves the e-file, the rook gives check.
steps.ifWrong: Move the bishop off the e-file and capture something big.
steps.ifRight: Discovered check: Black must answer the check, and the queen is lost.
